family: All Boolean signs in n=1,2,3 with every nonempty physical block; odd majority; addressing padded and flipped at the all-plus point
parameter_domain: Exhaustive n=1..3. Majority n=3,5,7,9 and canonical block sizes 1..n. Address truth tables a=1,2, padding r=1..4, padding block size b=1..r. Address histogram-only a=1,2,3, r=1,2,4,8,16,32, b in {1,r} deduplicated.
case_count: 1844 exhaustive function/block cases; 24 majority block cases; 20 direct addressing block cases; 33 addressing histogram-only cases
symmetry_reduction: No reduction in the exhaustive domain. Majority is permutation symmetric, so the first b coordinates represent each block size. Address padding coordinates are permutation symmetric, so the first b padding coordinates represent each padding block size. Histogram-only cases use the proved coefficient multiplicities, never enumerate larger cubes.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transforms and Fraction spectra; exact formal logarithm expressions indexed by rational arguments; rational atanh-series log intervals with 24 terms and an explicit tail, including power-of-two range reduction. No floating signs used as certificates.
memory_estimate: Less than 80 MB; largest direct table 1024 entries; histogram cases use O(1) coefficient classes regardless of dimension
pilot_domain: All function/block cases n=1,2; majority n=3 and all block sizes; direct addressing a=1,r=1,b=1; same log helper
proof_role: Finite exact checks verify the restriction identity, zero-context cancellation, paid channel/level terms and family formulas. Universal constants and all-parameter limits are supplied by analytic proofs; R_nat<=A I remains open.
